olga_csm: VanguardHealth submitted an onboarding request: 7B reranker + 33B summarizer, PHI-safe, Azure Dedicated HSM, EU-South residency. They want cost estimate before renewal at month 3 and p50 <200ms for reranker. Need intake owner.
rafael_ml: Quick check  7B reranker int8 should be fine for low latency. 33B summarizer with 1.5k context likely needs 2xA100s or quantized 4bit. What's their peak qps?
olga_csm: AM says reranker peak 180 qps, summarizer 25 concurrent. They prefer model artifacts in their blob store and want signed artifacts.
jen_security: Security items: 1) Azure Dedicated HSM attest + customer CMEK. 2) No plaintext request logs; store only hashed IDs and telemetry. 3) Offer client-side de-id; if we run redaction in-VNet require delete-after-processing SLA. Need legal addendum for PHI.
devex_kim: I'll prepare the runbook and a short SDK snippet for their infra team. Ask them to upload a 50-transcript eval set with safety labels. Also propose a 30-min tech walkthrough after creds are ready.
rafael_ml: Action list: benchmark 7B reranker int8 at 128 tokens, prototype 33B summarizer on 2xA100 with 1536 context, design routing: reranker fast-path, summarizer batched-streaming, draft canary (5 qps reranker, 2 summarizer for 48h).
deploy-bot: Onboarding ticket created: checklist items: infra creds, HSM keys, artifact access, canary config, dashboards. See /ops/onboard/3112468000.
jen_security: If canary p95 >750ms or customer reports token-cost concerns, escalate to renewal risk. I'll start the addendum draft.
olga_csm: Owners: @rafael_ml benches + canary, @devex_kim runbook, @jen_security security/legal. Scheduling kickoff tomorrow 10:00 CET. I'll update thread after the call. :calendar:
